title: A Unified Framework for Fair and Personalized Decentralized Learning under Communication Constraints
abstract: arXiv:2608.26493v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Decentralized learning systems aim to collaboratively train models across multiple clients without relying on a central coordinator. While decentralization improves scalability, privacy, and robustness, it also exacerbates three fundamental challenges: statistical heterogeneity across clients, fairness in client-level performance, and stringent communication constraints. This raises a natural question: \emph{how fair can decentralized learning be under limited communication?} We address this question by presenting a unified framework for decentralized learning under communication constraints, bringing together graph-based personalization, agnostic fairness, and compressed event-triggered communication. translated_title: 通信约束下公平且个性化的去中心化学习统一框架
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.26493v1 公告类型：新 摘要：去中心化学习系统旨在不依赖中央协调器的情况下，在多个客户端之间协同训练模型。虽然去中心化提高了可扩展性、隐私性和鲁棒性，但它也加剧了三个基本挑战：客户端之间的统计异质性、客户端级性能的公平性以及严格的通信约束。这引发了一个自然问题：\emph{在有限通信下，去中心化学习能有多公平？} 我们通过提出一个在通信约束下的去中心化学习统一框架来回答这个问题，该框架结合了基于图的个性化、不可知公平性和压缩事件触发通信。具体来说，我们提出了一种新算法DMFL-SQ，这是一种去中心化多任务学习算法，它在通信图上耦合个性化模型训练与不可知混合公平目标，同时减少通信开销。
tldr: 本文提出了一个统一框架和DMFL-SQ算法，结合图个性化、不可知公平和压缩通信，在有限通信下实现公平且个性化的去中心化学习。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a unified framework and DMFL-SQ algorithm that integrates graph-based personalization, agnostic fairness, and compressed communication to achieve fair and personalized decentralized learning under limited communication.
